title: Laravel Spark - Vue components
content:
<html><head></head><body>Laravel Spark is out and it is really exciting to work with. But it is different from building an application from scratch. It provides a lot of great features but this also means quite some new stuff to learn. Today I want to  show you how to use a Vue component in Spark.
            </body></html>
